english.title: Fly UK aircraft in Required Navigation Performance airspace w / o required navigation equipment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), which flew in Required Navigation Performance airspace when it was not equipped with area navigation equipment which enabled the aircraft to maintain the navigation performance capability notified, prescribed or otherwise designated for that airspace
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 84 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
